optimized_sql:
SELECT MIN(n.name) AS of_person, MIN(t.title) AS biography_movie
FROM person_info AS pi
JOIN name AS n ON n.id = pi.person_id
JOIN aka_name AS an ON an.person_id = pi.person_id
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.person_id = n.id
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = ci.movie_id
JOIN movie_link AS ml ON ml.linked_movie_id = t.id
JOIN link_type AS lt ON lt.id = ml.link_type_id
JOIN info_type AS it ON it.id = pi.info_type_id
WHERE pi.note = 'Volker Boehm'
  AND n.name_pcode_cf LIKE 'D%'
  AND n.gender = 'm'
  AND it.info = 'mini biography'
  AND lt.link = 'features'
  AND t.production_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1984
  AND an.name LIKE '%a%'
